# CIE Mathematics Study Hub

## Paper 1 · Pure Mathematics 1

::: {.course-grid}

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.1 Quadratics](paper-1/quadratics.qmd)

- Completing the square and quadratic graphs
- Discriminant, repeated roots and tangency
- Quadratic equations, inequalities and substitution
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.2 Functions](paper-1/functions.qmd)

- Domain, range, one-one and inverse functions
- Composite functions and compatibility of domains and ranges
- Function graph transformations and inverse graphs
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.3 Coordinate geometry](paper-1/coordinate-geometry.qmd)

- Straight lines, gradients, midpoints and perpendicular bisectors
- Circle equations, centres, radii, chords and tangents
- Line-circle intersections and distance-to-line methods
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.4 Circular measure](paper-1/circular-measure.qmd)

- Radians and degrees
- Arc length and sector area
- Chords, segments and composite regions
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.5 Trigonometry](paper-1/trigonometry.qmd)

- Exact values and trigonometric identities
- Equations in degrees and radians
- Sine, cosine and tangent graphs
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.6 Series](paper-1/series.qmd)

- Binomial expansion
- Arithmetic and geometric progressions
- Finite sums and nth terms
- Convergence and sums to infinity
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.7 Differentiation](paper-1/differentiation.qmd)

- Derivatives and chain rule
- Tangents, normals and gradients
- Stationary points and second derivative
- Connected rates of change
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [1.8 Integration](paper-1/integration.qmd)

- Reverse differentiation and constant of integration
- Definite and improper integrals
- Area between curves
- Volume of revolution
:::

:::

## Paper 2 · Pure Mathematics 2

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.topic-card}
### [2.1 Algebra](paper-2/algebra.qmd)

- Modulus equations, inequalities and graphs
- Polynomial division, quotient and remainder
- Factor theorem and remainder theorem
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2.2 Logarithmic and exponential functions](paper-2/logarithmic-and-exponential-functions.qmd)

- Laws of logarithms and exponential equations
- $e^x$, $\ln x$ and inverse relationships
- Linearisation using gradients and intercepts
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2.3 Trigonometry](paper-2/trigonometry.qmd)

- Six trigonometric functions and graphs
- Identities, compound angles and double angles
- $R$-form
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2.4 Differentiation](paper-2/differentiation.qmd)

- Standard, product and quotient rules
- Tangents, normals, stationary points and parametric differentiation
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2.5 Integration](paper-2/integration.qmd)

- Reverse differentiation and trigonometric integration
- Definite integrals and trapezium rule
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2.6 Numerical solution of equations](paper-2/numerical-solution-of-equations.qmd)

- Sign changes, root bounds and graphical considerations
- Fixed-point iteration, iteration tables and accuracy
:::

:::

## Paper 3 · Pure Mathematics 3

::: {.course-grid .paper-three}

::: {.topic-card}
### [1. Algebra - Functions](paper-3/algebra-functions.qmd)

- Modulus and graphs
- Polynomial division, factor and remainder theorems
- Partial fractions
- General binomial expansion and validity
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2. Logarithmic and exponential functions](paper-3/logarithmic-and-exponential-functions.qmd)

- Laws of logarithms and inverse functions
- Exponential growth, decay and graphs
- Logarithmic equations and inequalities
- Linearisation and exponential modelling
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [3. Trigonometry](paper-3/trigonometry.qmd)

- Six trigonometric functions and graphs
- Reciprocal, compound-angle and double-angle identities
- R-form conversion and trigonometric equations
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [4. Differentiation](paper-3/differentiation.qmd)

- Derivative rules, product and quotient rules
- Tangents, normals and stationary points
- Implicit and parametric differentiation
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [5. Integration](paper-3/integration.qmd)

- Standard integrals and reverse chain rule
- Substitution and trigonometric identities
- Integration by parts and partial fractions
- Areas
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [6. Numerical solution of equations](paper-3/numerical-solution-of-equations.qmd)

- Locating roots by graphs and sign changes
- Iterative formulae and fixed points
- Convergence, divergence and accuracy
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [7. Vectors](paper-3/vectors.qmd)

- Position vectors, displacement vectors and ratios
- Vector equations of lines and 3D intersections
- Scalar products, angles and perpendicular feet
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [8. Differential equations](paper-3/differential-equations.qmd)

- Separation of variables and first-order differential equations
- Particular solutions from initial conditions
- Rate-of-change models and interpretation
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [9. Complex numbers](paper-3/complex-numbers.qmd)

- Cartesian form, conjugates, modulus and argument
- Polar form, square roots and polynomial roots
- Argand diagrams and complex-number loci
:::

:::
